12292.note: Forever's demo tooltip reads word for word like Classic's ("Your next 5 melee attacks strike an additional nearby opponent") and the 30 Rage cost and 30 sec cooldown are unchanged; the sim's 10 sec aura is shorter than the 20 sec the Classic spell data carries, which is a sim question rather than a Forever one.

12296.note: Forever's tooltip names the 1 Rage per 3 sec that this id actually pays out in the sim, where the Classic tooltip only mentions the out of combat Rage decay and never says the talent generates anything.
12296.tooltip:
Passive
Generates 1 Rage every 3 sec while in combat, and reduces Rage loss while out of combat by 30%.

12328.note: Forever swaps the drawback: Classic lowers armor and all resistances by 20%, Forever takes 5% more damage of every kind, which is what the sim applies; the 10 Rage cost and 3 min cooldown are Classic's and were not shown.
12328.tooltip:
10 Rage
Instant
3 min cooldown
When activated, increases your Physical damage done by 20% and makes you immune to Fear effects, but increases all damage you take by 5%. Lasts 30 sec.

12723.note: The internal spell that deals the copied damage for auto attacks and most abilities; untouched by Forever and never shown to a player.

12727.note: Forever pays 5 Rage per blocked attack where Classic pays 1, and the sim also borrows this id with tag 1 for Master of Defense, a new Protection talent with no id of its own that gives 50% per point to generate 5 Rage per point on a dodge or parry and whose rank 2 is still unconfirmed.
12727.tooltip:
Passive
Increases your chance to Block attacks with your shield by 1% per point, and gives you a 20% chance per point to generate 5 Rage when you Block.

12815.note: Classic's 12815 is Sword Specialization rank 5, a talent Forever deleted; the sim reuses the id for the sword branch of Weaponmaster, whose per rank values (1% crit per point with an axe or polearm, 3% armor ignore per point with a mace or staff, 1% extra attack per point with a sword) come from the community talent calculator and whose own Forever id is unknown.
12815.tooltip:
Passive
Your successful melee attacks with a sword have a 1% chance per point to trigger an extra attack on the target.
(200ms cooldown)

assumptions: The proc chance is 12% per point, so 5/5 is 60%; only rank 1's 12% was shown
The two-handed weapon bonus is a flat 2 Rage at every rank rather than scaling
The proc only fires on white swings in the sim, although the tooltip says "when you deal melee damage with a weapon"
12964.note: Forever raises the proc chance from Classic's 8% per point to 12% and adds the two-handed bonus, but only rank 1 was shown so the per point slope is the sim's own.
12964.tooltip:
Passive
Gives you a 12% chance per point to generate 1 additional Rage when you deal melee damage with a weapon. This effect is increased to 2 Rage for two-handed weapons.

12975.note: Forever's demo tooltip matches Classic's (30% of maximum health for 20 sec, lost when it expires) and the sim keeps Classic's 10 min cooldown.

assumptions: The proc chance is 30% per point, which already passes 100% at 4/5 points and is capped at 100% by the sim; only rank 1's 30% was shown
The 2% Physical damage bonus stays flat at every rank
The buff lasts 12 sec at every rank and is not consumed by swings
13048.note: Forever rebuilt Enrage: any damaging attack can trigger it (Classic needs a critical strike) and the buff is a flat 2% Physical damage with no swing limit (Classic scales 5% to 25% and burns 12 swings), so Classic's rank 5 tooltip on this id is wrong in every clause.
13048.tooltip:
Passive
Gives you a 30% chance per point to deal 2% increased Physical damage for 12 sec after being the victim of any damaging attack.

1680.note: Base Whirlwind is untouched (25 Rage, 10 sec cooldown, up to 4 targets, Berserker Stance); the same id with tag 2 is the off-hand swing that Forever's Raging Blows talent adds, which is the talent's text and not this one's.

1719.note: The registration is Classic's exactly (15 sec, guaranteed crits, +20% damage taken, 30 min cooldown); the file's header comment claims a 50% crit / 12 sec / 5 min version that no Forever source mentions and that the code does not implement, and it predates the Forever fork.

18499.note: The spell is Classic's (10 sec, 30 sec cooldown, extra Rage from damage taken); Forever's Improved Berserker Rage keeps Classic's 5 and 10 instant Rage and only adds a snare break, which the sim has nothing to apply.

21838.ability: Battlegear of Might (5 piece Rage proc)
21838.note: Molten Core tier 1 set bonus, 20% chance at 1 Rage when damage is dealt to you, untouched by Forever.

21887.note: Battlegear of Wrath 5 piece bonus, 20% chance that the next offensive ability costs 5 less Rage; untouched by Forever.

23548.note: The set proc, not the Parry skill: 4% chance to parry the next attack after a block, untouched by Forever.

23894.note: Forever's Bloodthirst is 35% of attack power plus 30 with a movement speed buff, replacing Classic's flat 45% of attack power and its five stack heal; the sim carries Classic's rank 4 id 23894 while the Forever talent tree points at 23881, and the 30 Rage cost, 6 sec cooldown and the movement speed are all unmodelled carry-overs.
23894.tooltip:
30 Rage
Melee Range
Instant
6 sec cooldown
Instantly attack the target causing damage equal to 35% of your Attack Power plus 30, and increasing your movement speed by 10% for 10 sec.

24427.note: Trinket effect, +75 Strength for 1 min on a 6 min cooldown; the sim leaves out the 9 health per 5 sec the Classic tooltip also grants, which is an upstream simplification rather than a Forever change.

2457.note: The stance is unchanged, but note that Forever's baseline Tactical Mastery is not modelled here: stance changes keep only 3 Rage per point of Improved Tactical Mastery and an untalented warrior keeps none.

2458.note: Classic's +3% crit, +10% damage taken and 0.8x threat, all unchanged by Forever.

2565.note: Forever deletes Improved Shield Block from the tree, which leaves the base spell exactly as Classic has it: 10 Rage, 5 sec cooldown, +75% block for 5 sec, one attack.

26654.note: The internal spell that deals the copied damage for Whirlwind; untouched by Forever and never shown to a player.

assumptions: Improved Bloodrage rank 2 is 50%, twice rank 1's published 25%; only rank 1 was shown
Improved Bloodrage scales the 1 Rage per second as well as the instant 10 Rage, read from the word "all" in the tooltip
Bloodrage still costs 20% of base health and still has a 1 min cooldown, neither of which the sim models or Forever showed
2687.note: Forever's Improved Bloodrage reads "increases all the Rage generated by your Bloodrage ability", so it now scales the 10 Rage over time as well as the instant hit, and the amount this spell hands out is talent dependent.
2687.tooltip:
Instant
1 min cooldown
Generates 10 Rage at the cost of health, and then generates an additional 10 Rage over 10 sec.
Improved Bloodrage increases all of that Rage by 25% per point.

56638.note: A new Forever Arms talent with no Classic spell, so 56638 resolves to nothing in the Classic database and the UI shows a blank tooltip today; the id is borrowed from a later expansion's version of the same mechanic and Forever's own id is unknown, while the 2/4/6/8/10% per rank scaling is corroborated by the post BlizzCon write-ups.
56638.tooltip:
Passive
Your melee attacks against targets afflicted by your Rend have a 2% chance per point to activate your Overpower ability for 1 attack on your current target. Lasts 6 sec.

6554.note: Classic's rank 2 Pummel unchanged: 10 Rage, 50 damage, 10 sec cooldown, Berserker Stance.

71.note: The stance itself is Classic's 10% less damage taken, 10% less damage dealt and 1.3x threat; Forever's changes around it (Thunder Clap usable here, Defiance needing a shield) live in Thunder Clap's and Defiance's own text, not in this tooltip.

Shield Wall's own 30 min base cooldown, 10 sec duration and 75% reduction are Classic's values, carried over because Forever never showed the spell
871.note: Forever's Improved Shield Wall cuts the cooldown instead of extending the duration, so the cooldown on this spell is now talent dependent and only rank 1 of that talent was ever shown.
871.tooltip:
Instant
30 min cooldown
Requires Defensive Stance
Reduces the damage taken from melee attacks, ranged attacks and spells by 75% for 10 sec.
